## History

Edmund worked as a teacher at the [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough) High School and was known for being plain-looking yet extremely pleasant. During his courtship with his wife, Bertha, the two were rarely apart. Though he later passed away and was buried in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough) alongside Bertha, he left behind a bundle of affectionate letters that eventually allowed his daughter, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), to feel deeply connected to her late parents.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P19](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0019), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Relationships

### [Bertha Harcourt](../character/bertha-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bertha-harcourt--edmund.md)

Edmund was married to [Bertha Harcourt](../character/bertha-harcourt.md) until his death. Although both parents have passed away, their affectionate letters to one another survived, eventually allowing their daughter to feel a deep connection to their memory.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), +2 more_

- Spouse of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/edmund--nell-harcourt.md)

Edmund was the late father of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Though he died while she was young, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits his grave and reads a bundle of affectionate letters written between her parents, which helps her feel deeply connected to him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), +1 more_

- Parent of — father (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>
